regions.today: Warm and humid today, with long spells of sunshine developing. Highest temperatures of 23 to 27 degrees, though a degree or two cooler near the east coast, in light and variable winds.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with long clear spells. Staying warm and humid with lowest temperatures of 15 to 18 degrees in a light and variable breeze.
regions.tomorrow: It will be hot and humid tomorrow, with long sunny spells and mostly dry conditions. Highest temperatures of 27 to 30 degrees, with light or moderate east to southeast winds.
regions.pollen: Very high on Wednesday and Thursday.
